Loft's AI for Space group is building the stack that runs real machine learning in orbit; turning raw sensor data into decisions on the satellite itself, so insight reaches the customer in minutes instead of hours. You'll move between model compilation, runtime internals, quantization, and hardware-in-the-loop CI, sometimes in the same afternoon. About this role:

Own model compilation: turn partner ONNX models into optimized engines per accelerator (TensorRT, Hailo, AMD/ROCm), within power & thermal budgets
Build the ground-side compile & delivery path; define how a mismatched engine is detected/rejected on-node
Build performance tooling: benchmarking, profiling, operator-coverage matrices, and budget validation
